signed_grid.interpolation: signed linear values in log10(k); no log-abs, smoothing, or extrapolation
signed_grid.crossing_rule: exact zeros and sign changes linearly interpolated in ln(k); no Hilbert phase or unique oscillation labels

boundaries: Comoving zero crossings are phase diagnostics, not unique oscillation identities or a convergence proof.
Accuracy-level band powers are compared after the same direct-velocity comoving transformation and on the same grid.
Recombination, other implementation differences, observational likelihood, joint BBN, nonlinear physics, and model-family exclusion remain separate.
